meta.name: Alex Rivera
meta.tagline: I build fast, accessible web products — from database schema to pixel-perfect UI.

about.short: I've spent the last 6 years turning ambiguous product ideas into shipped software.
about.long: I'm a full-stack developer focused on developer tools and internal platforms. I like small teams, fast feedback loops, and code that's easy to delete. Outside of work I mentor junior engineers and contribute to a couple of open-source CLI tools.

experience.description: Leading the platform team rebuilding the internal deployment pipeline; cut average deploy time from 14 minutes to 3.
Built client-facing dashboards for logistics customers; introduced a shared component library adopted across 5 product teams.

education.details: Focused on distributed systems. Capstone project on eventual-consistency in offline-first mobile apps.
